Not published.** Karen Rothe · Council · challenger. Scored 2 Sep 2026 against **The Program — A City That Works v1.10 (31 Jul 2026)** using the 12-topic template and Decision 14. **The letter on this card is a dash.** An internal proposal sits at the bottom of the page and is Joa's to apply or reject. Evidence base is the authorized 2026 campaign site plus the 27 May launch coverage. No verified campaign social account, no updates posted, no events posted, no questionnaire located. ## Card
Field Value
Name Karen Rothe
Office Council

Platform URL (2026) [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/)

### The five doors (front of the live card) Each door is **said / record / yes / —**: a sourced sentence or a fact. Never a second grade.
Door Measure said / record / yes / — sentence or fact URL date
Tax cap M66 **—** No position on the residential tax rate, a cap, or a formula anywhere on the site or in launch coverage. The only fiscal sentence is about deferral, not about the rate. [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
Downtown order M26 / M27 **—** Her downtown text is about access and vibrancy, not order: "I want to remove the barriers stopping people from coming downtown and restore the vibrant downtown that has been lost." No enforcement, bylaw-hours or unified-command position published. [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
Housing M6 **—** No housing volume, composition, tenure or land position. "Affordability" appears once, as one word in a list of core local-government responsibilities. [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
Household bill M66d **—** Water, sewer, stormwater and the combined household number are not mentioned on the site or in launch coverage. [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
Written program — **yes** An authorized campaign site with three named themes — "Creating Trust Through Better Leadership", "Restoring Downtown, Protecting our Neighbourhoods", "Better Planning for Better Outcomes". Written, current, and signed. No targets, no costings, no named instruments, no dates. [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
## The 12 topics Column key: **answer** = the mark · **quote or fact** = the verbatim sentence, then context · **URL** · **date** = lastmod, retrieved. Read a row across and it is the one-line cell format. A dash is unknown, not a fail. ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
1 M6 housing supply + composition — No published position on supply, composition, missing middle, 3-bedroom share, below-market share or rental share. Site and launch coverage both checked. — —
2 M6b land bank + co-ops — City land, land bank and co-ops do not appear in any published text. — —
3 M7 permits + AI pre-screening — No permit-time position. No published standard, category or number. — —
4 M7b pattern-book housing — Pre-approved designs and expedited streams do not appear. Her stated interest in "art and building design" is background, not a source. — —
5 M8/M8b 5% vacancy, DCC cuts, suite amnesty — No vacancy target, no DCC position, no suite amnesty. — —
### 2 · Downtown order
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
6 M26 Public Order Team — No position on unified command, co-location, or a downtown operations desk. Her downtown sentence is scored once, on row 18 (M71). — —
7 M26b civilian crisis response — Crisis response and the right-responder question do not appear. — —
8 M27 bylaw hours 6am–10pm — No bylaw-enforcement hours position. — —
9 M28 data-targeted enforcement — Her "backed up by facts and data" sentence is about how council decides, not about enforcement targeting. Used as context on row 42; adjacency is not a source here. — —
10 M33 daytime sheltering bylaws — Sheltering bylaws do not appear. — —
11 M33b drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure) — Buffer zones and child-focused spaces do not appear. — —
12 M34–M37 encampments, reclaiming spaces, night lighting — Encampments, removal protocol and lighting do not appear. — —
### 3 · Household bill
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
13 M66 tax glide path (capped on the residential rate) — No tax-rate position of any kind. Naming "affordability" as a core responsibility raises the topic without a goal or an instrument, which is a Mention and a dash in every column. — —
14 M66b/c over-collection refund + debt rule **Partial 1.0** "The tendency is to kick the can down the road and leave the the bill for others to pay later. I won't do that." · Commits against intergenerational deferral, which is the argument M66c is built on, with no instrument behind it: no debt rule, no supermajority override, no published debt set, and nothing at all on the over-collection refund. Context, same block: "I know how much pain and financial hardship can be avoided by planning ahead." [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
15 M66d the Household Bill — The combined household number, water, sewer and stormwater do not appear. — —
16 M70/M70b provincial downloading ledger — No downloading position, no ledger, no refusal threshold. — —
17 M70c CRD cost and the Goldstream plant — The CRD, regional water rates and the filtration plant do not appear. — —
18 M71–M73d business, downtown, one mandate not a new office **Partial 1.0** "I want to remove the barriers stopping people from coming downtown and restore the vibrant downtown that has been lost." · Commits to a downtown outcome with no instrument and no number: no vacancy target, no levers named, no mandate, no flagship event, no economic plan. Which barriers is never stated. Context: "Without people in the economic and cultural heart of the city, we don't have a downtown," and, at launch, "When local businesses are healthy, people have jobs." [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
19 M74/M75/M76 capital threshold, short-stay parking (15-min grace; first-hour gated Year 2), permit fees — Parking, permit fees and the capital approval threshold do not appear. — —
### 4 · Host Nations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
20 M1–M5 Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5. — No published text on government-to-government tables, Indigenous procurement, lək̓ʷəŋən place names, cultural protocols or an urban Indigenous liaison. — —
### 5 · Homelessness and waitlists
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
21 M9/M9b/M64 tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated) — Demoviction, short-term rentals and indoor heat do not appear. — —
22 M10 transparent algorithmic waitlists — Housing allocation and waitlists do not appear. — —
23 M11 Housing First + STEP throughput — Homelessness is not addressed in any published text, including the launch interview. — —
### 6 · Families
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
24 M12/M13b/M13c childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is \$0 → M13d) — "a city where families can thrive; where young people can see a future, where seniors feel safe and connected" raises families, youth and seniors with no goal and no instrument. Mentions, so a dash in every column. Childcare spaces, family doctors and the 18–25 cohort are not addressed. — —
25 M13d standing School District 61 agreement — Schools and SD61 do not appear. — —
### 7 · Streets and mobility
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
26 M14/M16/M17/M18 cleanliness and the public realm — Graffiti, pests, sanitation hours and public art do not appear. "neighbourhoods feel welcoming, vibrant, and cared for" is tone, and tone is not a source. — —
27 M19/M22/M38/M40–M42b mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38) — "transportation" appears as one word in a list of core responsibilities. No corridor, signal, intersection, school-zone or safety-audit position. Mention, so a dash. — —
28 M20b/M23b walking and transit the City controls — The one sentence carrying "public transportation systems that work for all" is scored once, on row 41 (M65), under one sentence, one measure. Walking, sidewalks, crossings and the City's own transit levers are not addressed anywhere. — —
29 M24b/M25b accessibility and public washrooms — Accessibility audits and public washrooms do not appear. — —
30 M25 fix roads first — "infrastructure" appears as one word in a list of core responsibilities. No maintenance backlog, no pothole standard, no sequencing rule. Mention, so a dash. — —
### 8 · Policing and published safety
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
31 M28b business security cost-spreading — Business security costs do not appear. — —
32 M28d community paramedicine — Paramedicine and call-volume reduction do not appear. — —
33 M29/M29b VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force) — "public safety" appears as one word in a list of core responsibilities, and "safer communities" as one of four launch priorities. No VicPD funding, Esquimalt or regional-review position. Mentions, so a dash. — —
34 M30 smart LED lights, no surveillance — Streetlighting and the surveillance limit do not appear. — —
35 M31/M31b/M31c/M32 safety dashboard, published enforcement record, crime target — No safety dashboard, no enforcement record, no crime-reduction number. — —
### 9 · Beauty as a public good
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
36 M43–M46b heritage and cultural venues — Heritage standards, street furniture and cultural venues do not appear. — —
37 M45b/c pedestrianisation and the signature project — Her Centennial Square sentence is scored once, on row 50, as a process statement. Read in full context it objects to that plan and that timing, not to renewal, so it is **not** an Opposed mark here. Pedestrianisation and a signature project are not addressed. — —
38 M47–M49 heritage incentives, lighting, parks — Waterfront walkways, ornamental lighting and parks do not appear. — —
39 M50/M50b/M51/M52 culture, sport, and the arts funding floor — "the economic and cultural heart of the city" is a description of downtown, not an arts, sport or funding-floor position. — —
### 10 · A smaller scored Hall
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
40 M15 managed competition — Competitive testing of waste collection or street cleaning does not appear. — —
41 M65 rotating zero-based reviews **Weak 0.5** "I will be a responsible steward of our limited resources and will focus on the core responsibilities of local government: infrastructure, transportation, public safety, affordability, and public transportation systems that work for all." · Agrees with M65's jurisdiction test — is this the City's job — as a goal, with no instrument: no zero-based cycle, no grant threshold, no three-part test, no savings number. Note the tension: M23b's position is that transit is *not* a municipal decision, and she lists it as a core local responsibility. Not opposition, but flagged. [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
42 M67 quarterly performance dashboard **Weak 0.5** "Council has delegated its responsibilities to staff. This has created a lack of transparency, a lack of accountability, and an erosion of public trust." · Agrees with the goal M67 exists to serve — residents able to hold council to account between elections — with no instrument: no dashboard, no KPI set, no publication cadence. Context: "Perspectives and feelings matter and they need to be backed up by facts and data." [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
43 M68 overhead reduction by attrition — Headcount, attrition and administrative overhead do not appear. — —
44 M69 real-estate rationalisation — City real-estate holdings do not appear. Her 22 years as a strata property-management coordinator is professional background, and background is not a source. — —
45 M53/M53b/M53c GIS, AI consultation imagery, LIDAR — GIS, consultation imagery and LIDAR do not appear. Reading "backed up by facts and data" onto a GIS programme is adjacency, which the rules exclude. — —
46 M53d published municipal AI standard — Municipal use of AI does not appear. — —
47 M54–M57 local-tech procurement, open data, Wi-Fi, EV charging — Procurement, open data, Wi-Fi and EV charging do not appear. — —
### 11 · Climate and trees as operations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
48 M58/M58b/M64b climate, district energy, seismic — Climate targets, district energy and seismic or coastal resilience do not appear in any published text. — —
49 M59–M63 trees, mode share, ecosystems, emergency preparedness — No published position. Her career work on the 2017 Williams Lake evacuation and BC Search and Rescue funding is professional background, which the rules exclude as a source. This is the single largest gap between what she plausibly knows and what she has published. — —
### 12 · Neighbourhoods and integrity
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
50 M77/M78/M78b \$25M referendum threshold, 5-step process, material-change rule **Weak 0.5** "It shouldn't have taken a public outcry to stop the redevelopment of Centennial Square; a Council that listens and is engaged would have quickly realized it wasn't the right plan nor the right time." · Agrees with M78 step 1 — consultation before commitment — as a goal. A commitment to listen is not a named process: no 5-step sequence, no \$25M threshold, no material-change rule, and the sentence describes what a council would have done, not what she will do. [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
51 M79/M79b Integrity Commissioner + 60-day consultation response **Partial 1.0** "I commit to listening, communicating, and ensuring as much transparency as possible." · Commits, with no instrument: no Integrity Commissioner, no MNP implementation tracker, no 60-day response standard, no draft-before-adoption rule. "as much transparency as possible" is a discretionary standard, not a service standard. Context: her diagnosis that council has delegated its responsibilities to staff is the council-staff boundary problem the MNP report addresses. [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
52 M79c–f lobbyist registry, FOI fee, remuneration — Lobbyist registry, FOI fees, mandate letters and council pay do not appear. — —
53 M80/M80b/M80c neighbourhoods, language access, Local Area Plans **Weak 0.5** "Community associations have long been stewards of these neighbourhoods, and their hard-won experience is critical to the long-term health of our communities." · Agrees that neighbourhood associations should carry weight, with no instrument: no grant line, no delivery-partner role, no Local Area Plan programme, no schedule, nothing on language access. Context: "Victoria is a city of neighbourhoods." [https://www.karenrothe.ca/](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
54 M82/M82b community surveys, turnout and ballot access — Annual surveys, turnout and ballot access do not appear. — —
55 M81 Saanich amalgamation (one line, not the whole topic) — Amalgamation does not appear. — —
## Working notes (internal, not for the cell) - **Sources read in full:** [karenrothe.ca home](https://www.karenrothe.ca/) (retrieved 2026-09-02) · [About Karen](https://www.karenrothe.ca/about-karen) (retrieved 2026-09-02) · [Updates](https://www.karenrothe.ca/updates) — "No updates posted yet" (retrieved 2026-09-02) · [Our Events](https://www.karenrothe.ca/our-events) — no events posted (retrieved 2026-09-02) · [Victoria News launch coverage, 27 May 2026](https://vicnews.com/2026/05/27/a-city-where-families-can-thrive-vic-west-resident-to-run-for-council/) (retrieved 2026-09-02). - **Searched and not found:** any verified campaign Facebook, Instagram, X, Bluesky, Threads, TikTok or YouTube account; any completed candidate questionnaire; any all-candidates or forum transcript; any second news interview. Absence is recorded as absence, not as a fail. - **One sentence, one measure — the ledger.** Seven sentences carry the seven scored cells, each used once: (1) "kick the can down the road… I won't do that" → row 14. (2) "remove the barriers stopping people from coming downtown" → row 18. (3) "responsible steward of our limited resources… core responsibilities of local government" → row 41. (4) "Council has delegated its responsibilities to staff…" → row 42. (5) Centennial Square / "a Council that listens and is engaged" → row 50. (6) "I commit to listening, communicating, and ensuring as much transparency as possible" → row 51. (7) "Community associations have long been stewards…" → row 53. - **Contested allocations, recorded so they can be re-argued.** Sentence 3 was the closest available match for both row 41 (M65 jurisdiction test) and row 28 (M23b transit). It was placed on row 41 because "core responsibilities of local government" is M65's own test almost word for word, and because scoring her on M23b for calling transit a core municipal responsibility sits awkwardly against M23b's central point. Either placement yields Weak 0.5, so n and the mean are unchanged. Sentence 2 could arguably sit on row 27 (M19, traffic barriers) rather than row 18 (M71, downtown revival); she never says which barriers she means, and M71 is the closest whole. - **Actions found that contradict a 2026 sentence (measure, vote, source):** none. No City office held 2022–26, so there is no record to weigh, no 📋 line, and no incumbent cap applied. Challenger rule applied: 2026 plan taken at face value, no haircut for having no record. - **The Centennial Square line stays withdrawn as a divergence.** Her objection is to that plan and that timing, not to renewal as such, and M45c's own mechanism — consult, visualize, shortlist, referendum — is what she is asking for. It is scored once, on row 50, as agreement with process. A snippet is not a source, and it cuts both ways. - **Background excluded, deliberately.** The 2017 Williams Lake evacuation, BC Search and Rescue funding, the Metro Vancouver regional growth strategy and 22 years of strata property management are professional background. Under the rules, background is not a source. This costs her rows 44, 48 and 49 in particular, where she may well be the strongest candidate in the field and has published nothing to prove it. - **Rows to put to the candidate before publication:** row 14 (does "I won't do that" extend to a debt rule?) · row 18 (which barriers?) · row 41 (does "core responsibilities" mean a programme review?) · row 51 (does "as much transparency as possible" mean a published standard?) · rows 48–49 (will the emergency-management experience become a written commitment?). - **What would move this card fastest:** a costed fiscal section with a tax-rate position (rows 13–15), a housing paragraph with any number in it (rows 1–5), and one sentence on downtown order distinct from downtown vibrancy (rows 6–8). Three additions, three doors opened. - **Next mandatory re-check:** after nominations close **11 Sep 2026**, and immediately on any detailed platform release. The site carries no lastmod, so re-checks are by retrieval date only. - M83 (civic access / public correction, \$0) has no cell in this 55. Not scored. ## INTERNAL proposed letter — not the live letter **PROPOSE: D** · n = 7 · mean 0.71 Sum of scored marks: 1.0 + 1.0 + 0.5 + 0.5 + 0.5 + 1.0 + 0.5 = **5.0** across **7** scored cells. Mean **0.714**, which lands in the **D** band (0.50–0.99). D is already one of the five live letters, so no mapping is needed. **This is a proposal, not the live letter.** The card above shows **—**. The live letter waits for Joa's click and compute must not overwrite it. **What the proposal is measuring.** Not hostility to the Program — she is not Opposed on a single cell — but distance from it. Seven cells scored, and every one of them is a goal without an instrument. Two Partials and five Weaks is the arithmetic signature of a platform that agrees in direction and has published nothing to deliver with. Forty-eight cells are dashes because she has not spoken to them, not because she failed them. **Fragility.** At n = 7 the letter is thin. Two Partial-plus marks on a detailed release would carry the mean to 0.89 and hold D; four would carry it to exactly 1.00, into C−, which maps to **C** on the live set. A single costed fiscal or housing section is the difference between D and C. Hold the letter at **—** until after 11 Sep if there is any signal of a fuller platform coming.
